criteria.requirement: Validate Job interval as a positive finite nonboolean int/float at construction and revalidate before _schedule_next_run, because existing public attributes can be mutated. Raise ScheduleValueError before registering a callback or entering the next-run advancement loop for zero/negative/nonfinite/invalid types. Keep positive fractional fixed intervals working and original integer random intervals; reject noninteger random bounds clearly rather than delegating them to randint. Preserve deadline, timezone and weekday logic.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
